HistoryNotLoaded: Open a repository from the Repository menu to view its history.

HistoryMore: Scroll past the bottom for older commits, or use View → Older commits.

HistoryLoaded: History loaded — select a commit to inspect it
SectionUnavailable: This workspace is not implemented yet. Choose History to inspect commits.

HistoryCancelled: History loading cancelled. Existing rows, if any, are retained; retry or refresh.
AllCommitsHelp: All Commits: history reachable from local branches, remote-tracking branches, tags, HEAD and saved stashes, including detached HEAD. IdentityChanged: This repository’s identity changed. Automatic reading has stopped. Reopen the repository to read the new location.

HistoryCheckingCached: Showing cached history while checking repository identity…

HistoryCached: Cached history shown. Refresh checks external changes.
SameAuthorAccessible: {0}. Same author as the selected commit.

ActionExplainNewBranch: Create a local branch from the selected commit or reference. No existing branch is replaced. Checking it out requires a clean worktree.
ActionExplainSwitchBranch: Switch to an existing local branch. Requires a clean worktree; changes are never discarded.
ActionExplainFetch: Download remote branches into their remote-tracking refs. Rewritten remote tips are reflected locally; local branches are unchanged. No pruning. Reachable tags may be downloaded.
ActionExplainPull: Fetch the selected remote branch, then integrate it into your current branch.
ActionPullStrategyHelp: Rebase replays local commits on the remote tip and changes their hashes. Merge preserves local commits and creates a merge commit when branches diverge.
ActionAutoStash: Automatically stash and reapply local changes
ActionAutoStashHelp: Includes tracked changes only; untracked files stay in place. Reapplying can conflict, and staged changes may return unstaged. Submodule contents are not stashed or updated.
ActionIgnoredCollision: Incoming files overlap ignored local files. Move those local files before rebasing. They have not been overwritten.
ActionRebaseConflict: Rebase stopped and needs attention. Review Git output, resolve and stage conflicts, then choose Continue in the sidebar or Repository menu. Abort abandons the rebase. Any auto-stash remains under Git's control until recovery finishes. Refresh Shovel afterward.
ActionMergeConflict: Merge stopped and needs attention. Review Git output, resolve and stage conflicts, then choose Continue in the sidebar or Repository menu. Abort abandons the merge. Auto-stash recovery can also conflict. Refresh Shovel afterward.
ActionStashConflict: Pull left unresolved file conflicts, possibly while reapplying the auto-stash. Inspect git status and git stash list in a terminal. Resolve the files before further work; keep the recovery stash until your changes are verified. Refresh Shovel afterward.
ActionExplainPush: Publish the selected local branch to the named branch on the selected remote. Existing remote commits are not overwritten by force.
ActionRemoteBranch: Branch on remote (name without remote prefix)
ActionAllRemotes: Fetch every listed remote (sequentially; stop on failure)
ActionAllTags: Push all local tags as well (some refs may succeed if others fail)
ActionSetUpstream: Set this destination as the local branch's upstream
ActionAuthLimits: Uses existing credential helpers and SSH agents. Git credential and bundled OpenSSH prompts open in Shovel. Verify host fingerprints independently before accepting; OpenSSH may save accepted hosts. Browser sign-in through Credential Manager, interactive hooks and signing prompts still require your terminal. Shovel does not save credentials; configured Git helpers may store them.
ActionReady: Review the targets and options, then start this operation.
ActionOutput: Git output (in memory; URL credentials redacted)
ActionRunning: Git is running. Supported authentication requests open a prompt. Cancel if an unsupported hook or helper is waiting. Five-minute command timeout.
ActionCancelling: Stopping owned processes, then checking repository state…
ActionSucceeded: Operation completed. Review refreshed history before the next action.
ActionResultExited: Git reported failure. Some changes may already have applied; inspect the output and refreshed state. Resolve the cause, then reopen this dialog.
ActionResultCancelled: Stopped. Local or remote changes may already have applied. Review the refreshed state; cancellation is not rollback.
ActionResultTimedOut: Git timed out and was stopped. Check the output and repository state before retrying; changes may already have applied.
ActionResultOutputLimit: Git exceeded the output limit and was stopped. Check repository state before retrying; changes may already have applied.
ActionResultStartFailed: Git could not start. Check Git installation, permissions and available disk space.
ActionIdentityChanged: The repository identity changed or could not be verified. Close this dialog and reopen the repository.
ActionUnsupportedRemote: This remote configuration cannot be represented safely yet (multiple URLs, unusual name or too many remotes). Use your terminal for this configuration.
ActionOtherInstance: Another Shovel instance is changing this repository or a linked worktree. Wait for it to finish, then reopen this dialog.
ActionChanged: Repository refs, HEAD or configuration changed while this dialog was open. Nothing was started. Reopen the dialog to review current targets.
ActionChangedAfterFetch: Fetch completed, but repository state changed before fast-forwarding. The local branch was not advanced by Shovel. Review history and reopen the dialog.
ActionSequence: A Git sequence is already in progress. Use Local Changes and the recovery controls before starting another operation. Unrecognized sequences require your existing Git tools.
ActionWorktreeUnsupported: Branch checkout is not supported yet for repositories with submodules or sparse checkouts. Use your existing Git tools for switching branches.
ActionDirty: The worktree or index has changes, including untracked files. Commit, stash or move them with your existing tools before retrying. Shovel did not discard them.
ActionNoStart: No commit is available at the selected starting reference. Create the first commit with your existing tools, or choose another reference.
ActionNoRemote: No configured remote is available. Add one with your existing Git tools, then reopen this dialog.
ActionAttachedRequired: Pull requires an existing, checked-out local branch.
ActionBranchName: Enter a valid branch name without a leading dash, control characters or @ expressions. Existing branches are never replaced.
ActionOutputLimit: Combined output exceeded the one-megabyte limit. Earlier commands may have completed. Review repository state before retrying.
ActionCustomSsh: Custom core.sshCommand configurations require an interactive transport design that is not available yet. Use your terminal; configuration was not changed.
ActionSshMissing: The selected Git installation has no recognized bundled OpenSSH executable. Use your terminal or select a standard Git for Windows installation.
ActionReadFailed: Operation preparation or validation failed. Check repository availability, Git ownership, permissions and locks, then reopen the dialog. Shovel never deletes lock files automatically.
ActionAskPassMissing: The authentication helper is missing. Keep all preview files together, then reopen this dialog. No network operation was started.
ActionWaitingAuthentication: Waiting for authentication input. Cancelling the prompt stops this operation; changes already applied are not undone.
AuthPromptSource: Request from Git or a configured program (untrusted text):
AuthSafety: Only reply if this request matches the operation you started. For a new SSH host, verify the displayed fingerprint independently before typing yes. Replies are hidden, including usernames and host-key replies. Shovel keeps no credential copy after sending it; configured Git helpers may store credentials. This prompt expires after two minutes. Cancelling stops the operation without undoing changes.
ActionAuthenticationUnavailable: The authentication prompt connection failed or returned an invalid response. Git was stopped. Review refreshed repository state and reopen the operation to retry.
ActionAuthenticationTimedOut: The authentication prompt expired after two minutes. Git was stopped. Changes already applied are not undone; review refreshed state before retrying.
ActionAuthenticationPromptLimit: The operation exceeded the limit of 16 authentication requests and was stopped. Review the authentication configuration and refreshed repository state before retrying.
ActionAlreadyAttempted: Open the operation again to review current targets before another attempt.
ActionEnterBranchName: Enter a name for the new branch.
ActionChooseRemoteBranch: Enter the destination branch name on the remote.
ActionWorkspaceStarting: Wait for the workspace to finish starting or saving.
ActionOpenRepository: Open a repository to use this action.
ActionWaitForRead: Wait for the current repository read to finish, or cancel it from the Repository menu.
ActionSelectGit: Select a supported Git executable from the Repository menu.
ActionInspectionNeeded: Refresh the repository successfully before using this action.
ActionPullNeedsBranch: Check out a local branch with a commit before pulling.
ActionNeedsBranch: Create a local branch with a commit before using this action.
ActionCancelHelp: Stop the current Git command and its owned processes. Changes already applied are not undone. Cancellation is unavailable while repository state is being refreshed.
ActionWorkspaceBusy: Finish or cancel the current Git operation before starting another action.
ActionReinspectionFailed: {0} Repository refresh failed. Use Repository → Refresh to check the current state before another operation.
ActionUnexpectedFailure: The operation could not finish because of an unexpected error. Changes may already have applied. Review the output and refreshed repository state before retrying.
ActionCachedTargets: Locally known targets. Use Fetch for new remote branches; execution uses the remote's current Git configuration.
ChangesNotLoaded: Local Changes has not been read yet.
ChangesNoRepository: Open a repository to see local changes.

ChangesLoading: Reading local changes… Previous rows, if shown, are stale.
ChangesLoaded: Local snapshot: {0:G}. Refresh after external edits.
ChangesFailed: Status read failed; previous rows, if shown, are stale. {0}
ChangesCancelled: Status read cancelled; previous rows, if shown, are stale. Use Refresh to retry.
ChangesLimits: Read-only snapshot; Refresh and Cancel are under Repository. Up to 4 MiB / 20,000 entries; exceeding a limit shows an error, not a partial result. CommitWaitForRead: Wait for the local snapshot or current operation. Refresh to retry a failed read.
CommitStale: The repository or index changed. Refresh before retrying. Whole-file staging uses current on-disk contents.
CommitInvalidPath: This path cannot be used as a file within the current worktree.
CommitMessageLimit: The complete commit message must fit within 64 KiB of UTF-8 text.
CommitUnresolved: Resolve and stage all conflicted files before committing.
CommitReady: Commit the staged snapshot. Hold Shift to commit and push to the displayed upstream.
CommitDraftHelp: Message retained while this repository tab remains open.
CommitAmendTarget: Replace commit {0}. This rewrites its hash.
CommitAmendHelp: Replace the current commit with the staged snapshot and message. A confirmation identifies the commit before execution.
CommitConfirmAmend:
Replace commit {1} on {0}?

This rewrites its hash and may require coordinating published history. Reflog can help recover an earlier commit, but does not restore all uncommitted work. Shovel will not force-push.
CommitNoUnstaged: No unstaged files in the available snapshot.
CommitNoStaged: No staged files in the available snapshot.

CommitUnstageHelp: Unstage selected files without changing worktree files. Hold Shift to unstage all listed staged files.
CommitNoUpstream: No configured upstream. Use Push to set one before Commit and Push.
CommitPhaseCommit: Committing; configured hooks and signing may run
CommitSucceededCommit: Commit command completed. Review history before retrying if reinspection fails.
CommitCreatedPushFailed: Commit {0} was created, but push did not complete: {1} Use Push to retry; do not repeat the commit.
CommitRefreshHelp: Refresh local changes when idle, or cancel the current read/operation. Cancellation does not undo changes.
DiffChooseFile: Select a file to view its diff.
DiffSummaryBinary: Binary file · {0} B → {1} B. Text diff is unavailable.
DiffSummarySubmodule: Submodule pointer change; nested worktree files are not compared.
DiffSummaryDirectory: Directory or nested repository; select an individual file for a text diff.
DiffSummaryUnsupportedPath: A linked/reparse path cannot be previewed here.
DiffSummaryUnsupportedEncoding: Text is not valid UTF-8; no decoded preview is shown. {0} B → {1} B.
DiffSummaryTooLarge: Diff exceeds the preview limit. {0} B → {1} B. No partial text is presented.

DiffNoWhitespaceChanges: No changes remain with whitespace ignored.
DiffNoTextChanges: No text changes; metadata, mode or line-ending normalization may differ.

Binary sizes compare stored blobs with on-disk worktree bytes; submodules show pointers only.
CommitSucceededUnknownTip: Git completed the commit, but its new hash could not be read. No push was attempted. Refresh and inspect history before doing anything else.
HunkWaitForDiff: Wait for a fresh file diff before selecting change blocks.

HunkSelectChange: Select a line inside a change block. Ctrl/Shift selects multiple blocks.
HunkSelectedHelp: Selected change blocks: {0}. This action includes every change in those blocks and leaves worktree files unchanged.
HunkSelectionHelp: Selecting a line selects its complete change block for Stage/Unstage hunk. Ctrl/Shift selects several blocks; this is not individual-line staging.
HunkUnavailableChangeType: Hunks require a tracked text modification without a rename or mode change. Use Stage/Unstage for the whole file.
HunkUnavailableContentType: This content cannot be staged by hunk. Use the whole-file action when available.
HunkUnavailablePreviewOptions: Turn off Ignore whitespace and Whole file to select exact change blocks.
HunkUnavailableFiltered: This path uses a filter, working-tree encoding or ident conversion. Use the whole-file action to preserve Git's conversion.
HunkUnavailableNoChanges: No text change blocks are available.
HunkStale: The file, index or comparison settings changed after this preview. Refresh and select the change blocks again; no stale patch was applied.
HunkUnsupportedPath: This linked path or directory does not support hunk staging.

CommitPhaseUnstageHunks: Validating and unstaging selected change blocks
CommitSucceededStageHunks: Selected change blocks staged; worktree files preserved.
CommitSucceededUnstageHunks: Selected change blocks unstaged; worktree files preserved.

CommitFilesCount: Changed files: {0}. Comparison uses stored commit objects; working files are not included.
CommitFilesResize: Resize committed file list and diff

CommitTimings: Read drain: {0:N0} ms · Validation: {1:N0} ms · Git command: {2:N0} ms · Refresh: {3:N0} ms. File diff loads separately.
BinaryComparison: Old and new binary file sizes
CommitBackgroundRefreshFailed: {0} The full refresh failed; retained rows may be stale. Use Refresh in this window to check them.
RecoveryHelp: {0} in progress. Open Local Changes, resolve each conflicted file, then Continue.
RecoveryContinueHelp: Continue the detected operation using staged resolutions and Git's existing commit message. Hooks and signing remain enabled.
RecoverySkipHelp: Skip the current commit and discard its conflict resolution before continuing the sequence.
RecoveryAbortHelp: Abandon the detected operation. Review the affected repository and original tip before confirming.
RecoveryChanged: The operation or HEAD changed since it was displayed. Shovel will refresh its state. Review the new state before trying again.
RecoveryUnavailable: No supported operation is available for recovery. Refresh after external changes; use your existing Git tools for mailbox, ambiguous or oversized sequence state.
RecoveryPending: Git still has an operation in progress. Review the output and Local Changes, resolve and stage conflicts, then choose the next recovery action.
StashCreateHelp: Create saves staged and unstaged changes, then removes those changes from this worktree. Ignored files and submodule contents are excluded.
StashRestoreHelp: Ask Git to restore the saved index as well as working files. This can fail when changes conflict.
StashPopHelp: Apply the selected stash, then remove its entry only on success. Conflicts keep the stash.
StashApplyHelp: Select an entry from a successfully loaded list to restore its changes and keep the saved stash. Wait for any current operation to finish.
StashDropHelp: Select an entry from a successfully loaded list to remove its saved stash after confirmation. Wait for any current operation to finish.
StashOperationOutput: Stash operation output (in memory; URL credentials redacted)
StashTracked: All tracked changes — saved worktree versus base
StashStaged: Staged changes — saved index versus base
StashUnstaged: Unstaged changes — saved worktree versus index
StashNotLoaded: Stashes will refresh after this window opens.
StashRefreshing: Refreshing stashes; displayed entries may be stale.
StashCount: Saved stashes: {0}. Select an entry to inspect its files and diffs.
StashListLimit: The stash list exceeds this view's 1,000-entry limit. No partial list was loaded. Manage older entries with your existing Git tools.
StashMessageLimit: Use a stash message of at most 4 KiB without null characters.
StashInvalid: This entry is not a supported stash commit. Its contents have not been changed.
StashNeedsCommit: Create an initial commit before creating a stash.
StashChanged: The stash list changed. Refresh and review the selected entry before trying again.
StashInspectFailed: Git finished, but the resulting conflict state could not be checked. The stash was retained. Review the output and refresh Local Changes before proceeding.
StashApplyFailed: Application did not complete cleanly. The stash was retained; some files may have been restored. Review Git output and Local Changes. Resolve and stage each file in Local Changes; there is no stash Continue/Abort sequence. Do not blindly apply again.
StashAppliedRetained: The stash was applied, but its entry was not confirmed removed. Refresh the list and review the output. Do not apply again; Drop the saved entry only after verifying your files.
StashPopped: The stash was applied and its saved entry removed.
FileMenuSelection: Selected files: {0}. This menu keeps these targets even if the list changes.
FileMenuStale: The file list changed. Reopen the menu to review the current targets.
FileMenuStageHelp: Change the index for the selected files, or all files listed on this side. Shift does not change these explicit menu actions.
FileMenuSingle: Select one file for this action. Staging and copying paths support multiple files.
FileMenuDeleted: This entry is deleted. Show its containing folder in File Explorer instead.
FileMenuOpenHelp: Open the current working file using its Windows default application. This does not open the saved staged version.
FileMenuExplorerHelp: Select the working file in Explorer. If it is missing, open the nearest existing containing folder.
FileMenuBusy: Wait for the current command or file handoff to finish.
FileMenuCopyFailed: The paths could not be copied. The clipboard may be busy; try again.
FileMenuOpening: Opening the selected file location in Windows…
FileMenuOpened: The file request was handed to Windows. Refresh Local Changes after editing externally.
FileMenuOpenedFolder: The file is missing or is a directory; its existing folder was opened.
FileMenuOpenFailed: Windows could not open the file or folder, or did not respond in time. Check the default application, permissions and path. No Git changes were made.
FileMenuMissingFile: The working file is missing or is not a regular file. Use Show in File Explorer or refresh the file list.
FileMenuLinkedPath: Opening paths through filesystem links is not supported yet. Use your existing file tools for this path.
FileMenuShellBusy: A previous Windows file handoff is still running. Try again after it finishes.
FileActionUnsupported: This action requires ordinary files without unresolved conflicts or submodule directories. Resolve conflicts through the recovery workflow; nested repositories and filesystem links need existing tools.
FileActionSelectionLimit: Select at most 128 files with a combined path length below 16,000 characters for this action.
FileActionHelp: Use the selected files only. Required validation runs after submission; results and cancellation remain in Local Changes.
FileDiscardWorktreeTarget: {0} — discard unstaged changes; preserve staged content.
FileDiscardStagedTarget: {0} — discard staged AND unstaged changes; restore HEAD.
FileDiscardNewTarget: {0} — permanently remove this file and any selected new index entry.
FileStashTarget: {0} — stash staged and unstaged content for this path.

Repository: {1}
Save these selected paths, including selected untracked files, in a new stash and return their index/worktree state to HEAD ({0}). Unrelated working files stay in place. FileStashHelp: Save both staged and unstaged changes for selected paths, plus selected untracked files. Unrelated working files are left in place.
FileDiffToolHelp: Open one file in the configured Git GUI diff tool (diff.guitool, merge.guitool, diff.tool or merge.tool). Uses this list's comparison. Cancel stops owned tool processes; a tool that detaches itself is not tracked.
FileDiffToolMissing: No Git diff tool is configured. Set diff.guitool or diff.tool using your Git configuration, then refresh. Shovel does not choose an arbitrary installed tool or change global settings.
FileIgnoreHelp: Add literal selected paths to the root .gitignore. Files stay on disk; the rule file remains unstaged.
FileIgnoreExtensionHelp: For untracked files with extensions: add wildcard rules for these extensions to the root .gitignore, affecting matching untracked files throughout the repository.
FileIgnoreTracked: Ignore applies only to untracked files. It does not remove tracked files from the index.
FileIgnoreNoExtension: At least one selected file has no extension. Use Selected paths instead.
FileRulePathUnsupported: Ignore and LFS rules for paths containing control characters are not supported.
FileRulesTooLarge: The rule file exceeds the 1 MiB editing limit. Edit it using your existing tools.
FileLfsUntrack: Stop tracking selected paths with LFS

FileLfsMissing: Git LFS is unavailable to the selected Git installation. Install/configure it with your existing tools before enabling tracking.
FileLfsSetup: Git LFS filters are not configured. Configure Git LFS with your existing tools, then refresh. Shovel has not changed global configuration or hooks.

FilePatchTitle: Save selected changes as a patch
FilePatchWriting: Reading and saving the selected patch…
FilePatchSaved: Patch saved. Repository files and index were not changed.
FilePatchDestination: Choose a patch destination outside Git metadata and different from the selected source files.

FileIgnoreInherited: The root .gitignore rule was written, but at least one selected file is still visible or its ignored state could not be checked. Review nested ignore rules and the Git output; files remain on disk.
FileHistoryLoading: Reading file history… Existing content remains available.
FileHistoryEmpty: No committed history for this path at the captured HEAD.

FileHistoryMore: More file history is available. Choose Older to continue.

CommitSucceededExternalDiff: External diff finished. Working files have been checked again.
FileStashIndexRetained: The selected stash was saved, but the real index changed or could not be reset. Inspect Stashes and Local Changes before continuing; do not blindly repeat or apply the stash.
FileRulesEncoding: The existing rule file is not UTF-8. It was not rewritten; edit its encoding with your existing tools.
ActionExplainInit: Create a local Git repository in a new or existing folder. Existing files stay in place. Nothing is staged, committed or published.
InitChooseFolder: Choose a folder for the repository
InitBranchHelp: Leave blank to use Git’s configured default. Git’s template settings also apply. If this folder is already a repository, Shovel opens it without reinitializing it.
InitEnterDirectory: Enter an absolute folder path, or choose an existing folder.
InitReady: Ready. The folder and branch will be checked when you choose Create.
InitInvalidDirectory: Choose a valid absolute folder path. A file cannot be used as a repository folder.
InitInvalidBranch: Git does not accept this initial branch name. Choose a literal branch name without control characters or a leading dash.
InitNestedRepository: This folder is inside another repository. Open its root instead, or choose a folder outside it for the new repository.
InitBareRepository: This destination belongs to a bare repository. Choose a normal working folder outside it.
InitMetadataDirectory: A Git metadata folder cannot be used as the repository destination.
InitLinkedDirectory: Creating through a symbolic link or junction is not supported. Choose the actual folder path.
InitDestinationChanged: The destination changed while it was being checked. Inspect the folder before trying again.
InitAlreadyExists: The existing repository was opened without reinitializing it. The initial branch option was not applied.
InitSucceeded: Repository created and inspected. Use Commit to review and stage your files.
InitIncomplete: Initialization did not finish successfully. Any created files were kept. Inspect the command output and destination before trying again.
InitUnexpectedLayout: The resulting worktree is outside the requested destination. It was not opened; inspect Git’s output and configured templates.
InitCreatedUnverified: Git reported success, but the new repository could not be inspected. Files were kept. Inspect the output and open the folder when it is accessible.
BranchManageExplainDeleteBranch: Confirm deletion of the selected local branch and its tip below. Its reflog and branch configuration are also removed. Git permits deletion only when fully merged into its upstream, or HEAD when no upstream is set. Current and linked-worktree branches cannot be deleted. Working files and remote branches are retained.
BranchManageExplainSetUpstream: Choose an existing local remote-tracking branch as this branch’s upstream. This changes local tracking configuration without fetching, checking out or pushing. Choices are cached; submission checks the current refs and configuration.
BranchManageExplainUnsetUpstream: Remove the selected branch’s upstream configuration. Local and remote-tracking branches and working files are retained. Nothing is fetched or checked out. Git reports an error if no upstream is configured.
BranchManageNoRemoteRef: Choose an existing remote-tracking branch. If it is missing, close these options and use Fetch or Refresh first.
BranchManageCurrent: The current branch cannot be deleted. Select a different branch.
BranchManageOccupied: This branch is checked out in a linked worktree and cannot be deleted. No branch was switched automatically.
BranchManageChanged: The repository, branch tip, tracking target or configuration changed. Refresh and review the targets again; this operation was not retried.
BranchManageReady: Ready. Submission validates these cached targets and uses the current local Git configuration.
BranchManageSymbolicRef: This target is a symbolic ref. Select a concrete local branch or remote-tracking branch instead.
CommitDraftUnavailable: The commit draft could not be loaded or saved. Your editor text is retained for this session. Refresh retries; copy the text before closing the tab or app if saving still fails. Local drafts: {0}
CommitDraftInvalid: The saved commit draft is corrupt or unsupported and was preserved. Refresh retries after you move the affected file aside. Copy your editor text if no recovery copy can be saved. Local drafts: {0}
CommitDraftNewerSchema: A newer Shovel version owns this saved draft; its bytes were preserved. Use that version or move the file aside, then Refresh. Local drafts: {0}
CommitDraftChanged: Another Shovel profile changed this draft. Its text was preserved. Copy your editor text if no recovery copy can be saved; Refresh retries without overwriting either version. Local drafts: {0}
CommitDraftIdentityChanged: This repository identity changed. Draft storage is suspended for this editor. Copy your text, close the editor and explicitly reopen the repository. Local drafts: {0}
CommitDraftTooLarge: This draft exceeds the local storage limit. Shorten the subject or description, or copy the text before closing. Local drafts: {0}
CommitDraftRecovery: The main draft could not be replaced. This editor's text was saved in a separate .recovery.json copy; other draft data was preserved. Review the local copies before deleting them. Refresh retries. Local drafts: {0}
CommitDraftCopies: Additional .recovery.json draft copies were found from another session or profile. The main draft is shown; review the local copies for other text. Local drafts: {0}
CommitDraftCloseFailed:
Commit draft persistence needs attention. Reopen Local Changes to recover this session's editor text before closing its repository tab or Shovel. A previously saved message may reappear if clearing it failed.
{0}
CommitDraftPersistenceHelp: Messages save locally for this worktree and survive reopening. A successful commit clears the submitted draft.
SidebarLocateFailed: Could not locate this commit. Existing history was retained; refresh and try again.
SidebarSubmodulePath: This submodule path is unsupported or contains a link outside the expected worktree.
ActionExplainSubmoduleSync: Copy this submodule URL from .gitmodules into local configuration.
ActionExplainSubmoduleUpdate: Check out the recorded submodule commit without force or recursion.
SidebarFailed: Could not refresh repository lists. Cached entries are retained. Use Repository → Refresh to retry.
SidebarSubmoduleUnavailable: Submodule is not initialized or is inaccessible. Use Initialize / Update first.
WorkspaceAppearanceHelp: Choose the application theme. Windows high contrast takes precedence.
WorkspaceRiderHelp: Open the root-level Unreal project, solution or C# project in Rider. With multiple candidates, open the repository folder.
WorkspaceToolsHelp: Open this repository in an external application. Discovery happens after selection; missing tools can be selected manually.
WorkspaceToolOpened: Opening request sent. The external application controls its own window and lifetime.
WorkspaceToolFailed: Could not open the external application. Check that the repository and application are accessible, then retry.
WorkspacePreferenceSaveFailed: The preference works for this session but could not be saved. Settings remain available for recovery.
RemoteAddExists: That remote already exists. Choose another name.
RemoteAddInvalid: Enter a remote name and location without embedded passwords or URL query tokens.
RemoteAddReady: Saves configuration only. Fetch next, then set the branch upstream from Repository.
ActionExplainAddRemote: Save a remote in this repository. Fetch separately to download branches.
PullDefaultHelp: Pull using remembered options. Use the arrow to choose the target, strategy and automatic stashing.
PullDefaultNeedsUpstream: Set an upstream or choose a target in Pull options.
PullDefaultTargetChanged: The upstream changed or uses a custom mapping. Refresh or choose the remote and branch in Pull options.
DefaultFetchHelp: Fetch using remembered options. Use the arrow to choose a remote or all remotes.
DefaultPushHelp: Push using remembered options. Use the arrow to choose the destination, tags and upstream setting.
DefaultFetchNeedsTarget: No unambiguous remote is configured. Choose a remote in Fetch options.
DefaultPushNeedsTarget: No single branch push destination could be resolved. Choose a target in Push options.
HistoryCopyFailed: The SHA could not be copied. The clipboard may be busy; try again.
HistoryMenuHelp: Acts on this commit. Reopen the menu after history changes.
HistoryResetHelp: Choose how the branch, index and working files change.
HistoryResetNeedsBranch: Reset requires a checked-out local branch.
HistoryTargetUnavailable: The selected commit is unavailable. Refresh history and try again.
HistoryRevertMainlineRequired: Choose the parent to keep as the mainline when reverting this merge.
HistoryRevertParentHelp: Undo changes relative to the chosen parent; Git records a new commit.
HistoryEffectResetSoft: Soft moves the branch only. Staged and working-file changes are retained.
HistoryEffectResetMixed: Mixed moves the branch and replaces the index. Working files stay unchanged; previously staged changes become unstaged.
HistoryEffectResetHard: Hard moves the branch and replaces the index and tracked working files. Uncommitted changes are discarded. Untracked or ignored files obstructing target paths may also be deleted. Submodule contents are not reset.
ActionExplainCheckoutCommit: Check out the selected commit without moving a branch.
ActionExplainResetSoft: Move the current branch; retain index and working files.
ActionExplainResetMixed: Move the current branch and replace the index; retain working files.
ActionExplainResetHard: Move the current branch and replace index and tracked files.
ActionExplainRevertCommit: Create a commit that reverses the selected change.
ConflictCloseEdits: Close the editor and discard its unsaved text for {0}? Any file already written by a resolution attempt stays on disk.
ConflictOperationBanner: {0} in progress — resolve files in Local Changes, then continue, or abort the operation.
ConflictResolving: Applying resolution and staging this file…
ConflictResolved: The file is resolved and staged. Continue the operation after resolving the remaining files.
ConflictChoose: Select one side to keep it, or select both and edit the result. Resolve applies and stages this file.
ConflictIncomingUnknown: Incoming stash / patch / other side (stage 3; origin not recorded by Git)
ConflictDeletedSide: File absent on this side. Selecting it resolves this path as deleted.
ConflictBinarySide: Binary, LFS, unsupported encoding or large content. Select this side to restore it through Git.
ConflictBinaryHelp: This file cannot be edited as text here. Select exactly one side, or use your configured external merge tool.
ConflictEditorHelp: Choose a whole-file side, or keep both checked and edit the result below. Remove all conflict markers before resolving. Checkboxes only preview; Resolve applies and stages.
ConflictResolveHelp: Apply the selected side or edited result, then stage this file as resolved.
ConflictReloadRequired: Reload the conflict before another attempt. The displayed edit and output are retained.
ConflictUnsupported: This conflict involves a symbolic link or submodule. Resolve it with Git or its owning tool, then refresh.
ConflictEditedOutside: The working file changed after this preview. Your editor text is retained; copy it if needed, then reload before resolving.
ConflictTextLimit: The editor supports UTF-8 and BOM-marked UTF-16 text up to 512 KiB in the saved encoding, 20,000 lines and 16,384 characters per line. Use side selection or an external merge tool for other content.
ConflictMarkersRemain: Conflict markers remain in the edited result. Remove them before resolving.
ConflictToolMissing: No external merge tool is configured. Set merge.guitool or merge.tool in Git, or use Shovel's side selection/text editor.
ConflictStillUnmerged: The tool returned, but this file is still unmerged. Its content and output are retained.
ConflictNoLongerUnmerged: This file is no longer unmerged. Close this editor and refresh Local Changes.
HistoryStartupCached: Last-known view from {0:g}. Loading current repository data…
ActivityRetention: Session only · latest 128 entries, plus active work · output limited to 32 Ki characters per entry. URL credentials are redacted.
ActivityOutputLimit: Further output omitted from this activity entry.
DiffRetainedLoading: Loading selection… previous comparison remains visible.
UpdatePeriodic: Check every four hours while Shovel is open
UpdatePrivacy: Checks contact GitHub and send normal HTTP metadata, including your IP address; no repository content, credentials or device identifier. Checks never download or restart without your approval.
UpdateUnconfigured: Update hosting is not configured in this build. Set the release repository and public verification key when packaging.
UpdatePortable: Automatic updates require an installed copy of Shovel. Use the Windows installer first.
UpdateReady: Shovel {0} is ready. Restart and update when your Git work is finished.
UpdateCancelled: Update check or download cancelled. Your installed version is unchanged.
UpdateFailed: Update failed. Check your connection and available disk space, then retry. An invalid, incomplete or withdrawn release is never installed. Your installed version is unchanged.
UpdateBlocked: Shovel {0} is ready, but installation is blocked. Finish Git operations and recovery in all tabs, close external Git tools, and make sure every saved repository is accessible and settings are writable.
UpdateSettingsBlocked: Restart is blocked because this session cannot save its settings. Your settings file has been preserved. If it was created by a newer version, close Shovel and install the latest compatible installer; do not delete or downgrade the settings file.
UpdateInstalling: Saving your session and verifying the update before restarting…
UpdateOtherInstance: Another installed Shovel instance is running, or an explicit update is in progress. Close other Shovel instances first. If an update was interrupted, run the latest installer to repair the application.
UpdateToolsQuestion: Shovel opened an external editor or terminal whose completion cannot be tracked. Have you finished its Git commands, hooks, authentication and merge work?
CloneSource: Repository URL or absolute local path
CloneReady: Clone into a new or empty folder, then open its history. Leave the branch blank to use the remote default.
CloneInvalid: Enter a repository URL or absolute local path and an absolute destination folder. Leave the branch blank to use the remote default.
CloneNotEmpty: The destination folder is not empty. Choose a new or empty folder.
CloneIncomplete: Clone did not complete. Git output is retained; any partial repository has been left in place.
CloneUnverified: Git completed cloning, but Shovel could not inspect the destination. Open the folder again to retry.
RemotePushUrl: Push URL (blank uses the fetch URL)
RemoteManageReady: Edit the selected remote locally. Saving does not contact the server.
RemoteManageEmpty: No editable local remote configuration is available. Use Add remote to create one.
RemoteManageUnsupported: This remote has multiple URLs or an unsupported URL. Edit it with Git, or remove the remote.
RemoteManageChanged: Remote configuration changed since it was loaded. Refresh the repository and reopen Manage remotes.
RemoteManageLoading: Remote configuration is loading. Refresh the repository to retry if loading failed.
RemoteRemoveConfirm: Remove remote '{0}' from '{1}'? Its local configuration and remote-tracking references will be removed. Local branches, working files and the server repository remain unchanged.
ActionExplainClone: Clone the selected source into the destination folder and open its history.
ActionExplainEditRemote: Update the selected remote's local fetch and push URLs.
ActionExplainRemoveRemote: Remove the selected remote's local configuration and remote-tracking references.
CloneCancelled: Clone cancelled. Any partial repository has been left in place.
CloneTimedOut: Clone exceeded the ten-minute limit. Any partial repository has been left in place; use Git in a terminal for longer clones.
CloneOutputLimit: Clone stopped at the output limit. Output and any partial repository are retained; use Git in a terminal for this clone.
UpdateChannelHelp: Applies to manual and launch checks. Switching clears pending updates and checks the selected channel immediately. Returning to Stable waits for a newer stable version; it does not downgrade.
ConflictToolHelp: Choose a tool, then select External merge tool. Configure the saved Shovel tool in File → Settings. Git checks availability on launch. This does not change Git configuration or save editor text.
ConflictToolInvalid: The selected merge tool is no longer available in this preview. Reload the conflict and select it again.
UpdateOffered: Version {0} is available. Approve to download and restart.
SettingsFetchHelp: Applies to all open repositories. Default: 60 seconds; range: 10–3600 seconds. Fetch updates remote information without pulling changes into your working files. Background failures stay in Activity without interrupting you. Turning this off stops background fetches; manual Fetch remains available.
SettingsFetchIntervalInvalid: Enter a whole number from 10 to 3600 seconds.
SettingsReadOnly: This profile cannot be saved. Resolve the settings warning in the main window before changing these preferences.
SettingsSaveFailed: Settings could not be saved. Your edits are retained; try again.
SettingsMergeHelp: Used by External merge tool in the conflict pane. Saved for all repositories in Shovel; Git configuration stays unchanged. Saving does not launch a tool.
SettingsMergeNameHelp: For example: winmerge, kdiff3, meld, bc or a tool configured in Git. An executable path overrides its location, not its arguments.
SettingsMergeCommandHelp: Use Git shell syntax and quote paths, for example: "C:/Tools/merge.exe" --wait "$LOCAL" "$REMOTE" "$BASE" "$MERGED". Adapt arguments to your tool. It must wait until editing finishes, write the result to "$MERGED", and exit 0 only on success; nonzero on failure or cancellation. No success prompt is shown.
ConflictToolSettingsInvalid: Choose a supported external merge-tool mode.
ConflictToolNameInvalid: Enter a Git tool name of up to 128 letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens. It cannot start with a hyphen.
ConflictToolPathInvalid: Enter an absolute .exe path without quotes, or leave it empty to use Git’s configured location.
ConflictToolCommandInvalid: Enter a nonempty Git shell command of up to 8192 characters without NUL characters.
ConflictToolExecutableMissing: The configured merge-tool executable was not found. Update its path in File → Settings.
HistoryFileResetConfirm: Restore working file {0} to commit {1} in {2}? This replaces local file contents, or removes the file if absent in that commit. Staged changes are preserved.
HistoryFileTreeScope: Tree at {0} — {1}. Double-click a folder to open it.
HistoryFileWorking: Working on the selected historical file…
HistoryFileAbsent: This file does not exist in the selected commit.
SettingsScaleHelp: 70–200%, in 10% steps. Ctrl+Plus and Ctrl+Minus also adjust scale. Your choice survives restarts.
SettingsLayoutHelp: Window sizes, pane proportions, repository tab order and the selected bottom tab are remembered automatically.
SettingsAvatarRepository: Repository host — GitHub or configured Gitea
SettingsAvatarHelp: Enter the website base address, including any subpath, for example https://git.example.com. Matching repositories use that server; github.com repositories use GitHub. Pictures load in the background without Git credentials. Private, missing or unavailable accounts keep their initials. Gravatar uses a hash of the author email. Pictures are cached in memory for this session.
SettingsAvatarInvalid: Enter a valid HTTP(S) website address without credentials, query parameters or a fragment.
SettingsDiffDefault: Open comparisons side by side by default
SettingsDiffHelp: Applies to text comparisons in Commit and history. The comparison toggle still lets you change a view temporarily.
SettingsDisplayInvalid: Choose a scale from 70–200% in 10% steps and a diff font size from 9–24.
SettingsToolHelp: Leave an executable field empty to use automatic discovery when you choose Open in. Saving does not launch or discover tools.
SettingsToolPathInvalid: Tool overrides must be absolute paths to .exe files, or empty for automatic discovery.
SettingsPeriodicUpdates: Check periodically while Shovel is running
SettingsUpdatesHelp: Launch and the update window always check immediately. Download and restart still require your approval. Beta contains the latest builds for testing; Stable contains owner-approved releases. Switching to Stable does not downgrade an installed Beta.
SettingsIdentityHelp: Global Git identity is used for new commits unless a repository overrides it. Load reads your global configuration. Apply writes only user.name and user.email immediately; Cancel does not undo those explicit Git changes.
SettingsIdentityNoGit: Open a repository first so Shovel can use the selected Git installation.
SettingsIdentityLoadHelp: Choose Load global identity to read the existing values.
SettingsIdentitySaved: Global Git identity saved. Repository-specific overrides remain in effect.
SettingsIdentityLoaded: Global identity loaded. Edit the values and choose Apply.
SettingsIdentitySaveFailed: Git could not save the complete identity. A partial change may remain. Load the current values before trying again.
SettingsIdentityLoadFailed: Git could not read the global identity. You can retry Load.
SettingsIdentityInvalid: Enter a name and email without control characters (maximum 512 characters each).
SettingsIdentityChanged: Global Git identity changed since it was loaded. Load it again before applying edits.
QueuedRequestCancelled: Waiting request removed. No command was started.
QueueStoppedAfterFailure: Not started: an earlier operation in this repository failed or needs resolution. Submit again after reviewing the result.
OperationWaiting: Waiting for repository initialization or a conflicting operation
AppCommandRunningClose: Cannot close Shovel while a command or accepted request is running. It will finish in the background; you can keep using other repositories. See Activity for details.
CommitCloseBeforeReopen: Close the current Commit window first, then use Reopen Commit in Activity for the failed repository.
CheckoutDetachedHelp: Check out this commit. The repository will be in detached HEAD state.
CheckoutStash: Stash and reapply (including staged state and untracked files)
CheckoutDirtyHelp: Git protects files that would be overwritten. Submodule worktrees are left unchanged.
CheckoutReadFailed: Could not read local changes. Close this window and retry.
CheckoutChanged: Local changes changed after confirmation. Review them before trying checkout again.
CheckoutStashUnavailable: Could not verify the saved checkout stash. Inspect Stashes and Local Changes before retrying.
CheckoutStashRetained: The checkout stash was retained. Inspect Local Changes and Stashes; resolve any conflicts before continuing.
NetworkRememberOptions: Choices are remembered for the main button. Explicit destinations apply to this branch.
RustActionWarning: Completed with a warning — see details
RustNewBranchHelp: Create a local branch at the selected commit. If checkout is selected, review local changes before the branch is created and checked out.
RustDiscardCheckoutConfirmation: Confirm discarding the tracked changes listed below in {0}, then check out {1}. Staged and unstaged edits to these tracked paths will be lost. Untracked and ignored files are retained. There is no guaranteed undo.
RustConfirmDiscardCheckout: Discard reviewed tracked changes and check out
RustNetworkConfigured: The main button resolves the destination from current Git configuration. Editing a destination makes it explicit.
RustAuthExplanation: Replies are hidden and are not saved by Shovel. Verify a new SSH host fingerprint before approving it. This request expires after two minutes. Declining supplies no answer; Git determines the outcome and any changes already applied remain.
RustAuthUnavailable: The authentication connection failed or returned an invalid reply. Review Git's result and refreshed repository state before retrying.
RustAuthTimedOut: The authentication request expired. No reply was supplied. Review Git's result and refreshed repository state before retrying.
RustAuthPromptLimit: The operation exceeded 16 authentication requests. No further replies were supplied. Review Git's result and authentication configuration.
RustDiscardPartial: Discard did not finish. Some reviewed files may already have changed. Review the refreshed file list and Git output before trying again.
RustDiscardRemaining: Git finished, but some reviewed paths still have changes. Review the refreshed file list.
RustFileDeleteFailed: Windows could not remove a selected file. It may be read-only, in use, or inaccessible.
RustFileStashPartial: The selected stash operation did not finish. Files or a saved entry may already have changed. Inspect Stashes and Local Changes before retrying.
RustFileStashNotSaved: Git did not create a new stash for the reviewed selection. Local changes have been refreshed.
